about: the pinhole of the CMA 1957.40 photo, solved with the washer's form (objects/ru_washer/form.py); object frame: mm, z up, the axis at the origin, z = 0 the ground; right-handed (scene.py turns it into pbrt's left-handed LookAt)
model: pinhole, principal point at the photo's centre [A], square pixels, no distortion [A]
residuals_about: distance from each edge point (measure.py) to the projected edge of the fitted form, photo px (20 px/mm at the rim); the fit is robust (soft L1, 1.5 px), so a few far points are edge-finding failures (the right lower wall's soft limb, the foot's left end in shadow)
